question_text: What is the primary architectural intent of the Facade design pattern?

options.text: Dynamically add responsibilities to an object transparently
Provide a unified, simplified high-level interface to a complex subsystem
Convert the interface of a class into another interface clients expect
Ensure a class only has one instance

answer_explanation: A Facade encapsulates a complex set of subsystem interfaces behind a single, cohesive, high-level entry point, decoupling external consumers from internal subsystem churn.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: A Facade encapsulates a complex set of subsystem interfaces behind a single, cohesive, high-level entry point, decoupling external consumers from internal subsystem churn.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
